name: quality-quest
description: Quality Quest — offline-capable HTML learning game for healthcare quality and patient safety professionals.

scripts.lint:scenarios: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const dir=p.join(__dirname,'content','scenarios');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p.join(dir,'manifest.json'),'utf8'));let bad=0;for(const f of m.files){try{const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p.join(dir,f),'utf8'));if(!s.id||!s.module||!s.tier||!s.lo_id||!s.itemType){console.error('schema fail',f);bad++}}catch(e){console.error('parse fail',f,e.message);bad++}}console.log(bad===0?'OK — '+m.files.length+' scenarios valid':'FAIL — '+bad+' scenario(s) bad');process.exit(bad>0?1:0)"
